title: Malicious code in identity-poc (npm)
description: The identity-poc npm package version 1.0.3 contains malicious code that executes shell commands and reads sensitive files upon loading. It collects host identity information and contents of /etc/passwd, then exfiltrates this data to an attacker-controlled URL provided as a command-line argument. This behavior occurs immediately when the package is required or invoked via CLI, posing a risk of data leakage through dependency confusion or unintended package installation.
